cloudformation.reason: commit-bound cdk synth --all runs offline and WAS captured for both refs (Docker-free: network.mode=self_managed + aws:cdk:bundling-stacks=[] + a concrete account/region; base=2 stacks, patch=3 stacks). The closure computes 93 resource changes, but 76 are an API Gateway rollout (7 Resource A, 13 Method A, 53 Method M, Deployment A/D, Stage M). The validator only accepts API Gateway resources through the typed apply-api-routes model, which requires every non-OPTIONS method to equal one template-method behavior and is built for ADDING routes -- it cannot represent 53 heterogeneous modifications to existing methods (a mass CORS/integration reconfig). Owning that set through the typed path is infeasible for this diff, so the 10 D-cdk paths are classified AUTO_CLI/MANUAL_CLI_REVIEW from the source diff and the closure is left PENDING rather than shipped incomplete.

pool-core / edge / console / gateway orchestration sync: setup.sh, config.yml.example, console-bff web assets, edge fluent-bit, litellm bring-up, wazuh setup, hardening, vkey minting, and scripts/checks/* gate scripts; each replaced in place with a falsifiable check.

CDK stack sync translated to manual CLI (no stack redeploy): new openclaw-image-jobs DDB table + by-instance GSI (storage.py), dispatch consumer timeout/visibility/batch tuning (lambdas.py), host golden-AMI opt-in + new OpenClawHostImage/edge-bundle stacks, and observability/compute/helper wiring. Each resource is classified AUTO_CLI or MANUAL_CLI_REVIEW with its rollback policy.

params_changed.name: sqs:openclaw dispatch-consumer queue visibility_timeout
params_changed.runtime_impact: must stay strictly greater than the consumer Lambda timeout (now 900s) so SQS does not redeliver a still-running message; raising it only lengthens the redrive window for a genuinely stuck message — no data-plane change, applies to new dispatch messages only.

params_changed.name: lambda:openclaw dispatch-consumer function timeout
params_changed.runtime_impact: lets a single dispatch invocation run long enough to synchronously back up a suspend before returning; more wall-clock per invocation but reserved concurrency is unchanged, so fleet throughput and cost ceiling are bounded.

params_changed.name: lambda:openclaw dispatch-consumer event-source-mapping batch_size
params_changed.runtime_impact: one SQS message per invocation instead of ten serial messages; raises invocation count but removes head-of-line blocking so a slow tenant no longer stalls nine others — bounded by reserved concurrency, no data change.

verifications.action: aws lambda get-function --function-name <openclaw-api> --query Configuration.CodeSha256 and compare to the Step-1 pre-apply backup value
verifications.pass_when: CodeSha256 differs from the pre-apply backup (new code is live)

verifications.action: aws lambda invoke with a synthetic GET /images/channels (bootstrap/image route) event
verifications.pass_when: FunctionError=None (handler imports the new image_* modules without ImportError)
verifications.fail_when: FunctionError=Unhandled or an ImportError in the log tail

verifications.action: create a new LT version from the patched init-host.sh, point the ASG at it, launch ONE replacement host, watch its boot
verifications.observable: decoded UserData + openclaw-hosts registration + ASG lifecycle result
verifications.pass_when: no {{ }} placeholder in decoded UserData; host registers into openclaw-hosts; ASG lifecycle CONTINUE (not Heartbeat-Timeout/ABANDON)
verifications.fail_when: literal {{PLACEHOLDER}} in UserData, host never registers, or lifecycle ABANDON
verifications.cleanup: terminate the single test host; revert ASG to the prior LT version

verifications.action: on a host, byte-compare the replaced files to host-scripts/*.patched and run the per-type syntax check (bash -n for *.sh, python3 -m py_compile for *.py)
verifications.pass_when: diff empty vs the shipped .patched and every syntax check exits 0
verifications.fail_when: any diff beyond the intended change or a non-zero syntax check

verifications.action: create ONE tenant on a hot-fixed host via the real API and poll GET /tenants/{id}
verifications.pass_when: reaches running within the boot window (launch-vm.sh path works)
verifications.fail_when: stuck creating past the boot window

verifications.action: for each replaced deploy-other file, byte-compare to its host-scripts/*.patched artifact and run the per-type check (bash -n / node --check / py_compile / css+html load)
verifications.observable: diff result + per-type check exit code
verifications.pass_when: every file matches its shipped artifact and every applicable syntax check exits 0

verifications.action: aws dynamodb describe-table --table-name openclaw-image-jobs and describe its two GSIs
verifications.observable: TableStatus + IndexStatus for gsi_idempotency and gsi_host_created + TTL attribute
verifications.pass_when: table ACTIVE, TTL on expires_at, and BOTH gsi_idempotency and gsi_host_created ACTIVE
verifications.fail_when: table missing, TTL attr != expires_at, or either gsi_idempotency/gsi_host_created absent or not ACTIVE

verifications.action: aws lambda get-function-configuration on the dispatch consumer (Timeout), get-queue-attributes on its queue (VisibilityTimeout), and list-event-source-mappings (BatchSize)
verifications.fail_when: any value still at the old default (180/180/10) or VisibilityTimeout<=Timeout

verifications.action: after applying lib/image-routes.spec.json, curl each of the 6 new routes on the v1 stage with a valid x-api-key (GET /bootstrap/versions, POST /bootstrap/promote, POST /hosts/{id}/promote-canary, POST /hosts/{id}/reclaim-images, GET /hosts/{id}/image-slots, POST /delete-image-snapshot)
verifications.observable: HTTP status per route + apply-api-routes.sh verify exit code
verifications.pass_when: every new route returns a non-403/non-404 status (reaches the Lambda: 200/400/409 per input) and apply-api-routes.sh verify exits 0 (each method matches the template, OPTIONS/CORS carries If-Match+Idempotency-Key)
verifications.fail_when: any new route returns 403 Missing Authentication Token or 404 (method/resource never created), or verify exits non-zero

verifications.action: aws lambda get-function --function-name openclaw-lifecycle-consumer --query Configuration.CodeSha256 before/after overlay, then a synthetic import-probe invoke
verifications.observable: CodeSha256 change + FunctionError on probe invoke
verifications.pass_when: openclaw-lifecycle-consumer CodeSha256 differs from the pre-apply backup AND the probe invoke returns FunctionError=None (new image_*/bootstrap_* modules import cleanly in the consumer too)
verifications.fail_when: consumer CodeSha256 unchanged (stale code left in place) or probe invoke FunctionError!=None

verifications.action: lib/apply-fn-grants.sh verify $REGION $ACCOUNT_ID — check IMAGE_JOBS_TABLE env on api+consumer and the named inline IAM policies on each role
verifications.observable: env var value + presence of oc428-* inline role policies
verifications.pass_when: IMAGE_JOBS_TABLE=openclaw-image-jobs on both api and consumer, and inline policies oc428-image-jobs-txn/oc428-bootstrap-lt (api), oc428-consumer-txn (consumer), oc428-reaper-txn (health) all present
verifications.fail_when: any env var missing/wrong or any expected inline policy absent
